title: SAML: A fractal of bad design
summary: A Trail of Bits blog post critiquing SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language), arguing its design is fundamentally flawed and overly complex. The Hacker News discussion (264 points, 145 comments) debates SAML's security pitfalls, XML-based complexity, and whether alternatives like OIDC are better. Not directly about AI/ML, but relevant to authentication infrastructure used in enterprise ML systems.
